address: 140 Chomsurangyat Road, Nai Mueang, Mueang Nakhon Ratchasima, Nakhon Ratchasima, 30000, Thailand
bio: In over 30 years serving the community, this humble noodle spot has won local awards and built up a dedicated following. Expect a wait for their lovingly prepared dishes, which include deep-fried fish with thick noodles, and flavoursome crispy noodle stir-fry with holy basil....
